answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a rising identity bond: every extra persona an operator registers must lock a stake that scales quadratically with the total count. The first costs one juniper coin, ten cost a hundredfold, so splitting into a grove of fake agents burns far more capital than running one honest node. Duplicates caught by cross-checks are slashed, turning the once-solid basalt stake into a real deterrent.
